title: Log4Shell hid in a logging library's helpful feature
body: In December 2021 a JNDI lookup feature inside Log4j, present in staggering amounts of Java infrastructure, let attackers make servers fetch and run remote code from text they controlled, including usernames. Whether you used Log4j directly was almost irrelevant; dependencies of dependencies carried it. Inventory and reachability became the emergency questions, not patching speed alone.
